meta.name: Summarize market data and finance news with Google Gemini and Discord

parameters.content:
## Personal Finance Monitor

### How it works

1. Periodically fetch market data and news, normalize it and detect failures;  
2. Merge and deduplicate news, summarize with an AI model, then post a finance summary and save snapshots;  
3. Expose a webhook-driven command interface to fetch ad-hoc market, gold, USD and news data and reply in Discord;  
4. Record sent news rows and maintain a history table for later command queries.

### Setup steps

- [ ] Configure the Discord credentials/webhook used by the "Post to #finance-monitor", "Notify Admin (Error)" and "Post Command Reply" nodes.
- [ ] Add API keys/credentials for any HTTP sources: currency API (USD rates), gold price API, and Yahoo Finance (if required) in the httpRequest nodes.
- [ ] Configure the Google Gemini node credentials / API key and make sure the node has access to the summarization model.
- [ ] Ensure the dataTable nodes point to configured tables/storage (Load Last Market Snapshot, Upsert Market Snapshot, Load Sent Finance News, Record Sent News, and all CMD Load History nodes).
- [ ] Open the webhook endpoint (Command Webhook) to the service sending commands and ensure parse logic in "Parse Command" matches that input format.

### Customization

Change schedule frequency, add/remove RSS sources, tune the Gemini prompt in "Build AI Prompt", or adapt command handlers in the Command Router to add new bot commands.

## Scheduled start and load

Trigger that runs every 6 hours and loads the last stored market snapshot before fetching fresh data.

## Fetch forex and gold

HTTP requests to fetch USD/INR exchange rates and the current gold price (first leg of market data retrieval).

## Fetch and normalize indices

Chain of HTTP calls to fetch NIFTY, SENSEX and BANK NIFTY followed by normalization code to assemble market data.

## Data check and routing

Checks whether market data retrieval succeeded; notifies admin on error or passes data onward when ready.

## Fetch news feeds

Read RSS/feeds (RBI, ET, Livemint, CNBC, Fed) and merge incoming feed items into a single stream.

## Load and filter news

Load previously sent news rows and run deduplication/filtering logic to keep only new relevant items.

## Build and summarize prompt

Construct the AI prompt from filtered news and market context, call Google Gemini to summarize and build the final finance message.

## Post and record outputs

Post the summary to Discord, persist/upsert the market snapshot, expand news rows and record which news were sent.

## Command webhook ingress

Webhook trigger, parse incoming command payload and route to the appropriate command handler.

## CMD: load market history

Command flow that loads stored market history then re-fetches USD, gold and index data and builds a market reply.

## CMD: fetch single stock

Fetch a single stock's data and build the reply for the command interface.

## CMD: compare list

Build a compare list, fetch all entries and produce a comparative reply for the user command.

## CMD: build universe & score

Create the stock universe, fetch details and run scoring logic before returning results to the user.

## CMD: load gold history

Load gold history, fetch current gold price and build a gold-specific reply for commands.

## CMD: load USD history

Load stored USD history, fetch current USD rates and build a USD reply for the command interface.

## CMD: recent news reply

Load recently sent/saved news and build a reply containing recent headlines for the command requester.

## CMD: help reply

Build the help/usage reply for the command interface (single node building the help text).

## Post command reply

Single Discord node that posts replies to commands coming from all command handlers.
